name: Steve Gearhart

bio.statement: King City's council bio page lists Gearhart as council president.
Gearhart's pamphlet statement lists 12 years in sales management.
Gearhart's pamphlet statement lists HR management studies at Portland Community College.

positions.statement: In his voters' pamphlet statement, Gearhart cites more than 600 people asking the council not to let Fischer Road go through.
positions.excerpt: More than 600 people contacted City Council and said “Do not let Fischer Road go through”.

positions.statement: Gearhart's pamphlet statement says the city hired a consultant on how to better control Fischer Road.
positions.excerpt: hired a consultant to determine how we can better control Fischer Road.

positions.statement: Gearhart's pamphlet statement says rapid new growth makes listening to residents more critical.
positions.excerpt: With the rapid new growth, it’s even more critical to listen to our residents

positions.statement: Gearhart's pamphlet statement says he listens first and works through differences.
positions.excerpt: I listen first, work through differences, and help people find a way forward.

collection_notes: King City council bios page lists seven councilors: Rachel Kazmierski, Stephen Gearhart, Vince Arditi, Sandra Cunningham, Gary Mitchell, Linda Quanstrom, Jan Tysoe. The city's candidate-filings page lists completed filings for Dirksen, Cunningham, Gearhart, Suesserman (spelled 'Susserman') and Buehner, and James M Minor as a prospective petition. Step 4/5 searches returned only older (2016-2023) Pamplin/WW coverage or other King Cities; not used to keep treatment equal. Name on city site 'Stephen'/'Steven'. A 2023 WW article and Ballotpedia page on a 2023-24 King City recall surfaced; not fetched or used.

endorsements.statement: Steve Gearhart's pamphlet statement lists Rachel Kazmierski as an endorser.
endorsements.excerpt: Endorsed by Rachel Kazmierski, Mayor of King City
